P1_quota_append: At a genuine Chromium quota failure during a second real guest append, the owner is paused, recording is false, the writer/maintenance lease is released, Retry is available, and the original revision+canonical manifest+checkpoint frame remain byte identical. No named session is removed.
P2_retry: After space returns, Retry appends current guest state at revision 2 without changing checkpoint 1. If another tab deleted or replaced history at the same revision, Retry refuses before publication and leaves owner state identical.
P3_unique_accounting_migration: For independent payloads (including duplicate 1-MiB parts), payloadBytes equals the sum of unique persisted chunk Blob sizes, not objects/session references. Byte or point refusal leaves its transaction and prior commit unchanged. Migrating a real v1 database preserves revision, every manifest byte, and all object/chunk bytes.
P4_delete_reachability: After deleting the parent only private objects/chunks disappear. Every original sibling manifest, machine/assets, complete-map disk leaf, and out-of-line event payload still authenticates to its original hash. A real sibling machine restore is paused with exact RAM/native/disk/input/output identities and original guest file/shell memory.
P5_crash_gc: Crashing the renderer just after durable row deletion leaves the parent absent and siblings intact; crashing before strict sweep commit leaves all referenced data and accounting coherent. Reopen plus cleanup succeeds without losing any surviving original root/payload.
P6_corrupt_survivors: A corrupt/missing surviving row/root/object/event/disk leaf or unknown GPU/extension refs prevents sweeping rather than omitting that history. Repair/delete plus Retry cleanup works. Missing named rows stay visibly incomplete and cannot Open; explicit Delete clears them.
P7_leases: Across independent varied schedules, a held writer or reader rejects exclusive delete/GC with MaintenanceBusy, held exclusive maintenance rejects new writers/readers, duplicate writers return WriterBusy, and immediate release/reacquisition succeeds without stale locks or deadlocks.
P8_visible_controls: Origin usage/quota and persistence results are visible, valid limits save, invalid limits refuse, deletion confirms and can cancel, errors preserve clear delete/retry controls, and mobile controls do not overflow.
P9_scope_coverage: Every changed executable source line is covered by a recorded invocation or has an explicit bounded exception. V8 offsets must be mapped as UTF-16 code units. Loader worker-only restore admission must have actual construction/restore evidence. Generated mirrors/hash manifests match runtime bytes and the retained 47-file GPU factory.
P10_submission_provenance: The final gate, public deployment and one scrubbed pristine-source acceptance all pass with source hashes matching frozen implementation head; original recording/profile remain available and receipt SHA256/length match files.
A1_novel_attack: Bounded independent attack: hold the exclusive maintenance lease after gc-marked using DevTools, then race a new writer, a read lease, and duplicate cleanup from another page. All must reject MaintenanceBusy, and releasing the held collector must preserve every original content hash. Also retry a paused recording after same-revision manifest replacement rather than only row deletion.
A2_sabotage: In an owned temporary source/server copy, sabotage either indirect-event-payload or complete disk-leaf marking. The new retention storage assertions must fail on missing retained bytes. Production code and original evidence remain untouched.
